$comment: The paths that define the guardrails (`chock check --floor`, floor/control-plane-changed). Matched with fnmatch after case folding, so `*` crosses `/`; a leading `**/` also matches at the top level; a symlink or gitlink at a parent folder of a pattern matches too. Every symlink the control plane reaches must resolve, through the trees at base and head, to a control-plane path, or the run is undecided. A pull request that adds, changes, deletes or re-modes one, in the tree diff or in any of its commits, is listed; the base's `.chock/config.yaml` decides refuse or listed. Whole folder, at any depth, for every agent chock or agentseam writes into (hooks, permissions, MCP, plugins, skills, subagents), plus the engine's CI workflow and store files; tests/test_floor_control_plane_list.py checks the list against the engine's own data. Instruction files (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md) are left out: they steer an agent, they are not guardrails. `.gitattributes` is left out: the floor reads attributes from the base. What chock knows about, not a proof of completeness.
